views.definition:
SELECT c.snapshot_id,
    c.iso3 AS subject_id,
    c.year,
    v.variable_key,
        CASE v.variable_key
            WHEN 'DEM.BIO_POP'::text THEN c.biological_population
            WHEN 'DEM.SYNTH_POP'::text THEN c.synthetic_population
            WHEN 'DEM.RECOGNIZED_POP'::text THEN c.recognized_person_population
            WHEN 'DEM.MEDIAN_AGE'::text THEN c.median_age
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_UNDER_20'::text THEN c.age_under_20
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_20_64'::text THEN c.age_20_64
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_65_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_65_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_80_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_80_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_100_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_100_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_120_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_120_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_150_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_150_plus
            WHEN 'WORK.LEGACY_EMPLOYMENT'::text THEN c.legacy_employment
            WHEN 'WORK.LABOR_CAPABLE_BIO'::text THEN c.labor_capable_biological_population
            WHEN 'WORK.BIO_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.biological_effective_labor
            WHEN 'WORK.SYNTH_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.synthetic_effective_labor
            WHEN 'WORK.MACHINE_TASK_CAPACITY'::text THEN c.machine_task_capacity
            WHEN 'WORK.TOTAL_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.total_effective_labor
            WHEN 'ECON.VALUE_ADDED'::text THEN c.value_added
            WHEN 'ECON.GROSS_OUTPUT'::text THEN c.gross_output
            WHEN 'ECON.CAPITAL'::text THEN c.capital
            WHEN 'ECON.INVESTMENT'::text THEN c.investment
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END AS numeric_value,
    v.unit,
    v.definition,
    v.epistemic_status,
    v.derivation_method AS derivation_id,
    v.source_artifact_hashes AS source_artifact,
    v.misuse_warning
   FROM loom_narrator.current_country_year c
     JOIN loom_narrator.fact_semantics v ON true
  WHERE
        CASE v.variable_key
            WHEN 'DEM.BIO_POP'::text THEN c.biological_population
            WHEN 'DEM.SYNTH_POP'::text THEN c.synthetic_population
            WHEN 'DEM.RECOGNIZED_POP'::text THEN c.recognized_person_population
            WHEN 'DEM.MEDIAN_AGE'::text THEN c.median_age
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_UNDER_20'::text THEN c.age_under_20
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_20_64'::text THEN c.age_20_64
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_65_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_65_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_80_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_80_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_100_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_100_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_120_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_120_plus
            WHEN 'DEM.AGE_150_PLUS'::text THEN c.age_150_plus
            WHEN 'WORK.LEGACY_EMPLOYMENT'::text THEN c.legacy_employment
            WHEN 'WORK.LABOR_CAPABLE_BIO'::text THEN c.labor_capable_biological_population
            WHEN 'WORK.BIO_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.biological_effective_labor
            WHEN 'WORK.SYNTH_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.synthetic_effective_labor
            WHEN 'WORK.MACHINE_TASK_CAPACITY'::text THEN c.machine_task_capacity
            WHEN 'WORK.TOTAL_EFFECTIVE_LABOR'::text THEN c.total_effective_labor
            WHEN 'ECON.VALUE_ADDED'::text THEN c.value_added
            WHEN 'ECON.GROSS_OUTPUT'::text THEN c.gross_output
            WHEN 'ECON.CAPITAL'::text THEN c.capital
            WHEN 'ECON.INVESTMENT'::text THEN c.investment
            ELSE NULL::double precision
        END IS NOT NULL;

WITH sid AS (
         SELECT current_earth_snapshot.snapshot_id
           FROM loom_narrator.current_earth_snapshot
        )
 SELECT a.snapshot_id,
    a.iso3,
    a.display_name,
    d.year,
    d.biological_population,
    d.births,
    d.deaths,
    d.median_age,
    d.age_under_20,
    d.age_20_64,
    d.age_65_plus,
    d.age_80_plus,
    d.age_100_plus,
    d.age_120_plus,
    d.age_150_plus,
    e.value_added,
    e.gross_output,
    e.investment,
    e.capital,
    ll.legacy_employment,
    ll.legacy_labor_force,
    l.labor_capable_biological_population,
    l.biological_effective_labor,
    l.synthetic_population,
    l.synthetic_effective_labor,
    l.machine_task_capacity,
    l.total_effective_labor,
    l.recognized_person_population,
    a.economic_qualified,
        CASE
            WHEN e.iso3 IS NULL THEN 'DEMOGRAPHY_ONLY'::text
            ELSE 'ECONOMICALLY_QUALIFIED'::text
        END AS economic_coverage,
        CASE
            WHEN l.iso3 IS NULL THEN 'NOT_MODELED_BY_THIS_AUTHORITY'::text
            ELSE 'MODELED'::text
        END AS biosynthetic_labor_coverage
   FROM sid
     JOIN loom_earth.earth_area a USING (snapshot_id)
     JOIN loom_earth.earth_demographic_year d USING (snapshot_id, iso3)
     LEFT JOIN loom_earth.earth_economic_year e USING (snapshot_id, iso3, year)
     LEFT JOIN loom_earth.earth_legacy_labor_year ll USING (snapshot_id, iso3, year)
     LEFT JOIN loom_earth.earth_labor_composition_year l USING (snapshot_id, iso3, year);

SELECT snapshot_id,
    subject_id,
    year,
    variable_key,
    numeric_value,
    unit,
    definition,
    epistemic_status,
    derivation_id,
    source_artifact,
    misuse_warning
   FROM loom_narrator.current_country_fact;

SELECT s.snapshot_id
   FROM loom_control.snapshot s
     JOIN loom_control.model_context_record m ON m.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id AND m.context_key = 'model_designation'::text
  WHERE s.state = 'VALIDATED'::text AND (m.context_value #>> '{}'::text[]) = 'EARTH_LEAN_BIOSYNTHETIC_COUPLED_SUCCESSOR_v0_1_2026_09_24'::text
  ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
 LIMIT 1;

WITH sid AS (
         SELECT current_earth_snapshot.snapshot_id
           FROM loom_narrator.current_earth_snapshot
        ), d AS (
         SELECT earth_demographic_year.year,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.biological_population) AS biological_population,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_under_20) AS age_under_20,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_20_64) AS age_20_64,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_65_plus) AS age_65_plus,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_80_plus) AS age_80_plus,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_100_plus) AS age_100_plus,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_120_plus) AS age_120_plus,
            sum(earth_demographic_year.age_150_plus) AS age_150_plus
           FROM loom_earth.earth_demographic_year
             JOIN sid sid_1 USING (snapshot_id)
          GROUP BY earth_demographic_year.year
        ), e AS (
         SELECT earth_economic_year.year,
            sum(earth_economic_year.value_added) AS value_added,
            sum(earth_economic_year.gross_output) AS gross_output,
            sum(earth_economic_year.investment) AS investment,
            sum(earth_economic_year.capital) AS capital
           FROM loom_earth.earth_economic_year
             JOIN sid sid_1 USING (snapshot_id)
          GROUP BY earth_economic_year.year
        ), l AS (
         SELECT earth_labor_composition_year.year,
            sum(earth_labor_composition_year.synthetic_population) AS synthetic_population,
            sum(earth_labor_composition_year.synthetic_effective_labor) AS synthetic_effective_labor,
            sum(earth_labor_composition_year.biological_effective_labor) AS biological_effective_labor,
            sum(earth_labor_composition_year.machine_task_capacity) AS machine_task_capacity,
            sum(earth_labor_composition_year.total_effective_labor) AS total_effective_labor
           FROM loom_earth.earth_labor_composition_year
             JOIN sid sid_1 USING (snapshot_id)
          GROUP BY earth_labor_composition_year.year
        )
 SELECT sid.snapshot_id,
    d.year,
    d.biological_population,
    l.synthetic_population,
    d.biological_population + l.synthetic_population AS recognized_person_population,
    d.age_under_20,
    d.age_20_64,
    d.age_65_plus,
    d.age_80_plus,
    d.age_100_plus,
    d.age_120_plus,
    d.age_150_plus,
    l.biological_effective_labor,
    l.synthetic_effective_labor,
    l.machine_task_capacity,
    l.total_effective_labor,
    e.value_added,
    e.gross_output,
    e.investment,
    e.capital,
        CASE
            WHEN d.year <= 2100 THEN 'WPP_2024_MEDIUM'::text
            ELSE 'MED_CENTRAL'::text
        END AS demographic_status,
        CASE
            WHEN d.year <= 2100 THEN 'V4_PREDECESSOR'::text
            ELSE 'MED_CENTRAL__SYNTH_CENTRAL'::text
        END AS economic_status
   FROM sid
     CROSS JOIN d
     LEFT JOIN e USING (year)
     LEFT JOIN l USING (year);

SELECT v.snapshot_id,
    v.variable_key,
    v.human_label,
    v.definition,
    v.unit,
    v.grain,
    v.population_accounting_basis,
    v.epistemic_status,
    v.interpretation,
    v.misuse_warning,
    v.valid_from_year,
    v.valid_to_year,
    v.temporal_grain,
    v.coverage_scope,
    v.source_model_identity,
    v.selected_scenario,
    v.derivation_method,
    v.source_artifact_hashes,
    v.predecessor,
    v.future_limitation
   FROM loom_control.variable_semantics v
     JOIN loom_narrator.current_earth_snapshot s USING (snapshot_id);

SELECT m.snapshot_id,
    m.context_key,
    m.context_value,
    m.description
   FROM loom_control.model_context_record m
     JOIN loom_narrator.current_earth_snapshot s USING (snapshot_id);

SELECT c.snapshot_id,
    c.fact_family,
    c.variable_key,
    c.coverage_scope,
    c.valid_from_year,
    c.valid_to_year,
    c.temporal_grain,
    c.geographic_coverage,
    c.source_model,
    c.epistemic_status,
    c.handoff_predecessor,
    c.unavailable_intervals
   FROM loom_control.temporal_coverage c
     JOIN loom_narrator.current_earth_snapshot s USING (snapshot_id);
